title: Unit tests for etl4/vault/watermark.py
objective: Author pytest unit tests covering etl4/vault/watermark.py (T-02). Cover positive, negative, boundary, null, exception, determinism, and the shared-transaction semantics that are the module's load-bearing contract.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Tests clean up their own data (no residual rows in pipeline_watermarks)
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Post-run SELECT count(*) WHERE layer LIKE '__t25_%' returned 0
No non-cp1252 chars in test file or output

fixture_design.autouse_fixture: _scrub_test_rows deletes rows WHERE layer LIKE '__t25_%' both BEFORE and AFTER each test for crash-safe isolation
fixture_design.skip_on_no_db: pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(not _postgres_reachable(), ...) so the whole module skips cleanly when etl4-postgres is down
fixture_design.no_mocks: Tests hit real Postgres because the invariants under test ARE the DB behaviour (CHECK regex, txn visibility, UPSERT)

notes: Test count exceeds the 8-test minimum (15 effective test cases via parametrisation on 9 test functions). Added a bonus test test_set_upsert_advances_last_ym_on_second_call that exercises the DO UPDATE branch of the UPSERT with different args, which the idempotence test (identical args) does not cover.
